reason: 实现 v0.1：8 个本地模块全部新增。预期行为：任一 MCP 客户端可派发 deep/light/review 任务到 codex、dsh、claude，执行者只在各自 worktree 改动，检查按 birdview 语义记录，规划者审阅后 apply 或 discard；Claude 规划者在等待时由 mod 每 55 分钟 fork 保活并在任务结束时被唤醒。验证：node --test（策略、存储、适配器、真实 git 加伪造执行者的集成流程、MCP 协议），claude plugin validate 与 claude plugin test（模拟时钟）。

en.reason: Implement v0.1; all 8 local modules are new. Expected behavior: any MCP client dispatches deep/light/review jobs to codex, dsh or claude; executors change only their own worktrees; checks follow Birdview semantics; the planner reviews and applies or discards; a Claude planner is kept warm by a 55-minute fork while waiting and woken when a job ends. Verification: node --test (policy, store, adapters, real-git integration with a fake executor, MCP protocol) plus claude plugin validate and claude plugin test with a mock clock.

reason: 第 1 组：派发策略与配置。档位 profile、执行者设置、路径规则、目录前缀重叠判定，以及执行者角色、预留执行者、light 档护栏的拒绝逻辑。

en.reason: Group 1: dispatch policy and configuration. Tier profiles, executor settings, path rules, directory-prefix overlap, and refusals for the executor role, reserved executors and the light-tier guard.

reason: 第 2 组：任务存储与状态机。任务目录、原子写、跨进程锁、状态迁移校验、事件日志、心跳存活检测与观察者记录；记录里只保存环境变量名。

en.reason: Group 2: job store and state machine. Job folders, atomic writes, cross-process locks, transition checks, the event log, heartbeat liveness and the watcher record; records keep environment variable names only.

reason: 第 3 组：Git 隔离。基线快照（含未提交改动，提示未跟踪文件）、每任务 worktree 与分支、.git/info/exclude、改动清单与补丁、apply 前检查、discard 清理。

en.reason: Group 3: git isolation. Baseline snapshots (uncommitted changes included, untracked files reported), one worktree and branch per job, .git/info/exclude, change lists and patches, checked apply and discard cleanup.

reason: 第 4 组：执行者适配器。codex exec、claude -p、dsh headless 的命令构造与输出解析，执行者提示词，环境变量白名单与按名透传；agy/ACP 失败关闭；伪造执行者按各家文档化接口模拟。

en.reason: Group 4: executor adapters. Command lines and output parsing for codex exec, claude -p and dsh headless, the executor prompt, the environment allow-list with pass-by-name; agy/ACP fail closed; a fake executor emulates each documented interface.
